historical_reviews.v3_1: Changing the SEL clock changes the timestamp basis for subsequent evidence. The raw 0x30/0x42/0x00 may control time synchronization, but that cannot be inferred merely because the next row uses payload 0x01. Its exact firmware contract and restoration effect must be documented before use.

original_test_intent: Set the selected BMC's SEL clock to one approved value, verify exact readback and expected time-source interaction, then restore the original clock/time-sync state while preserving event chronology.
original_method: Capture SEL time, offset, synchronization mode and representative event timestamps; validate one owner-approved target time and documented set path; coordinate or disable competing synchronization only by vendor procedure; perform one write, verify bounded exact readback, then restore and prove the original clock/time-source policy.
manual_activity: The owner approves the target timestamp, offset semantics and time-sync handling; the vendor/package owner validates any raw command and the operator reviews chronology and restoration before the final verdict.
required_inputs: Original SEL time and UTC offset
Approved target timestamp and time basis
Vendor meaning of raw 0x30/0x42/0x00 if retained
safety_requirements: Do not target production/shared evidence without explicit authorization
Stop on overwrite or readback mismatch
Never retry an ambiguous write automatically
agent_execution_scope: Capture exact readback and sync behavior
Archive no-clear evidence and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve vendor raw command or remove it from execution

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The set/get concept matches but the SSH command omits `ipmitool`, is not protected OOB, ignores the raw 0x30/0x42/0x00 step and provides no original-state restoration or offset policy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use one protected documented `ipmitool sel time set` operation with approved timestamp semantics after baseline capture and time-sync coordination, followed by exact get/readback and restoration; omit raw 0x30/0x42/0x00 unless vendor-approved.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/10-minute read-raw-set sequence is preserved at intent level; the raw step is gated rather than guessed, and the missing restoration is added without clearing logs.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a chronology ledger of reference time, original BMC time/offset/sync mode, approved converted set value, command/readback timestamps, any NTP overwrite, representative SEL events and restored final state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds vendor validation, time-basis control and complete restoration while removing insecure transport and unqualified raw execution.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No-error completion does not prove the intended time persisted, used the right timezone or left event chronology recoverable.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Restoring the numeric clock cannot undo timestamps already written during the shifted interval; the evidence must explicitly retain that interval and its offset.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define whether raw 0x30/0x42/0x00 disables synchronization and whether that step is required before manual set. NTP enablement in row 1658 remains a separate case and cannot be assumed as automatic cleanup.
expected_evidence: Approval, exact target and original time/offset/sync baseline
Vendor raw-command contract or explicit omission
Approved timestamp conversion and protected set/get responses
Representative SEL chronology across the changed interval
Restored clock/time-sync state, no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets setting BMC time; the unexplained raw step is an unsafe undocumented prerequisite whose meaning must be supplied, not an explicit competing test objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Timestamp semantics, vendor raw documentation and restore procedure are obtainable project inputs. Execution blocks if raw meaning, time basis or restoration cannot be established.

review_improvement: Turns a chronology-altering write into a single controlled and restored transaction and prevents inference of an OEM raw command from adjacent payloads.
independent_technical_reasoning: SEL timestamps written while the clock is shifted remain historically altered even after restoration. Therefore the test must bound and label the changed interval, capture synchronization behavior and retain representative events. An immediate readback also may precede NTP correction, so later bounded verification is needed to distinguish successful set from time-source overwrite.
